page.overview:
Who is Fearne Calloway?

Lady Fearne Calloway () is a faun druid/rogue and member of the Crown Keepers and later Bells Hells. She is played by Ashley Johnson.

Fearne is a faun. She is a little over six feet tall when measuring from her horns, with white spotted fur, spiraling horns and ample breasts. She has large deep-green eyes (very similar to her mother's), large furry ears, and sea-foam green hair. Her hooves have bits of moss around them. She wears flowy clothing and is covered in poisonous flowers including hemlock and oleander. She has a tail which wiggles when she feels she's being "naughty", although since it's hidden under her clothing it's usually not visible.

During her travels with the Crown Keepers, as she got nearer to the gate to the Feywild her appearance changed. One of her eyes changed from a humanoid to a goat-like pupil, and the flowers she wore began to turn and open. After holding the Circlet of Barbed Vision, one hand blackened and became claw-like. When she visited the Fey Realm with Bells Hells, her appearance similarly modified, with her features becoming more elongated and exaggerated.

When Fearne entered into a pact with Teven Klask, the Retribution of the Hells, the slightly flaming mark of a black horned crown (the symbol of Asmodeus) appeared on the central knuckle of her hand. She also got a tattoo of a flaming bell in her inner thigh. Later, when Fearne summoned Teven after the gods became mortal, he told her Asmodeus would return someday and their pact remained in force. When he left, the mark on her hand from his kiss had spread, now covering her entire hand in dark hellish runes and designs.
